# Security policy

This module reads face and eye tracking data from Virtual Desktop and passes it to VRCFaceTracking.

## Reporting

Please don't open a public issue. Use [a private security advisory](https://github.com/RealWhyKnot/VirtualDesktop.VRCFaceTracking/security/advisories/new) so we can work out a fix before anything is published.

I try to reply within 7 days. There's no bug bounty.

## In scope

- The module sending tracking data anywhere other than VRCFaceTracking.
- A release archive that doesn't match its published checksum.

## Out of scope

- Problems in Virtual Desktop or VRCFaceTracking themselves.
- Attacks that need admin access to your PC already.
